meta.title: Meet My Agent Crew
meta.subtitle: One home server, a handful of agents, one shared memory

components.label: Agent Crew
components.sublabel: one job each: review, security, memory, routing

cards.title: It's a team, not a bot
items: One box on my network runs several small agents, each doing one job well
That's easier to trust than a single do-everything assistant

cards.title: Not everything needs the cloud
items: Routine, low-stakes work runs on my own hardware
The cloud is for the hard problems, not the easy ones

cards.title: One memory, everywhere I am
items: Whatever the crew learns syncs to every device I use
I never have to re-explain myself to a new session

cards.title: Want the deeper cut?
items: This gallery has a closer look at what's inside the crew, and how the memory sync actually works
